The 2025 Kia Soul S puts practical capability and everyday comfort within reach, delivering a vehicle that adapts to your lifestyle without compromise.

This compact crossover is built with features that matter:

- Radio: AM/FM/MP3/HD Audio System
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- Navigation System
- Auto High-beam Headlights
- Fully automatic headlights
- Delay-off headlights
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear

- Traction control

- Split folding rear seat

The Soul S combines efficiency with everyday practicality. Its 2.0L four-cylinder engine delivers 29 MPG in the city and 35 MPG on the highway, making fuel stops less frequent and budgeting more predictable. Power steering, power windows, and remote keyless entry handle routine tasks with ease, while the telescoping steering wheel and tilt steering column ensure a comfortable driving position for any body type.

Safety receives genuine attention here. The vehicle includes multiple airbag systems, Electronic Stability Control, and traction control to help you navigate various road conditions. The Exterior Parking Camera Rear and auto High-beam Headlights add practical assistance when you need it most. Speed-sensing steering and a front anti-roll bar contribute to controlled, confident handling.

Inside, the environment feels thoughtfully designed. The front bucket seats with woven and tricot cloth trim provide comfort during daily commutes, while the split folding rear seat adapts to your cargo needs. Climate control, full power accessories, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep distractions minimal and convenience high. The navigation system, combined with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, keeps you connected and informed.

The white exterior with black roof presents a clean, modern profile that works in any setting. Carpeted floor mats protect the interior, and the collection of thoughtful details trip computer, compass, outside temperature display, and illuminated entry demonstrate that this vehicle is designed for real-world ownership.

We invite you to experience the Soul S firsthand and discover how it fits your daily needs.

This 2024 Subaru Outback Premium represents a smart investment in reliable, capable transportation that prioritizes your comfort and safety every time you drive.

This 2021 Jeep Compass Latitude in white combines practical design with thoughtful features that make every drive more comfortable and convenient.

- Heated front seats and heated steering wheel for cold weather comfort
- Remote start system for convenient engine operation
- 7.0 color driver information display cluster
- Uconnect 4 infotainment system with 7 display and smartphone integration
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- Power 8-way driver seat with 4-way power lumbar adjustment
- SiriusXM satellite radio with six speakers
- ParkView rear back-up camera
- Altitude Special Edition styling with gloss black accents and 18 black aluminum wheels
- All-season floor mats and reversible cargo mat
- Windshield wiper de-icer
- 115V auxiliary power outlet
- Four-wheel independent suspension with 3.73 axle ratio

The Compass Latitude represents a capable choice for drivers seeking four-wheel drive capability with everyday practicality. Its 2.4L four-cylinder engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission delivers efficiency, achieving 22 city and 30 highway miles per gallon. The 4WD system provides added traction when conditions demand it, while the responsive steering and well-tuned suspension create a composed driving experience.

Built-in safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, front and rear anti-roll bars, electronic stability control with traction control, and brake assist. The ParkView back-up camera helps during reversing maneuvers, and low tire pressure warning monitors your tires throughout ownership.

Interior comfort extends to climate control with front dual zone air conditioning and rear window defroster, ensuring all occupants remain comfortable regardless of season. The premium cloth and vinyl bucket seats provide support for daily commuting and longer drives. Split folding rear seating adds flexibility when you need to accommodate passengers or cargo.

The Altitude Special Edition exterior styling distinguishes this Compass with its black grille, black roof, gloss black fog lamp bezels, and distinctive black tailgate badge, all complemented by the signature gloss black Jeep badge and bright exhaust tip.

This Compass delivers the reliability and capability Jeep owners expect, presented in a compact package that handles both urban environments and off-road situations. Its combination of efficiency, features, and proven engineering makes it a straightforward choice for your next vehicle.

The 2015 Lexus RC 350 was created for drivers who wanted far more personality than a traditional luxury coupe without sacrificing the refinement, dependability, and everyday comfort that have made Lexus one of the most respected luxury brands in the world. Sculpted with dramatic bodywork, a driver-focused cockpit, and a naturally aspirated V6 under the hood, this RC delivers the kind of balanced grand touring experience that's becoming increasingly difficult to find.

Whether you're enjoying a winding back road or simply commuting home after work, it inspires confidence without compromising refinement.

The result is smooth, immediate throttle response, a satisfying exhaust note, and long-term durability that has become one of the engine's defining strengths. Some competitors prioritize aggressive performance at the expense of ride quality, while others focus so heavily on comfort that they lose their emotional appeal. Owners also appreciate that the RC was engineered during an era when naturally aspirated engines were still common throughout the luxury market. The cabin further reinforces that philosophy. Rather than chasing headline horsepower figures, the RC delivers the kind of balanced ownership experience that ages exceptionally well. While some competitors leaned toward harsher, track-oriented personalities, the RC earned recognition for delivering a more sophisticated grand touring experience that owners could comfortably enjoy every day.
Kelley Blue Book consistently recognized Lexus as one of the industry's leaders in long-term resale value and ownership satisfaction. Lexus has earned an enduring reputation for exceptional dependability through numerous J.D. Power Vehicle Dependability Studies. The RC benefits from Toyota and Lexus engineering philosophies that emphasize long-term durability, quality control, and owner satisfaction. Power door mirrors with turn signal indicators, power windows, and a power-assisted rear window wiper add to daily ease of use.

This is a one-owner vehicle with a clean Carfax report, indicating a well-maintained history. With under 58,000 miles, this Pathfinder S is ready to serve your family for years to come. description:
This 2019 Chevrolet Equinox LT in Black combines practical design with capable performance for drivers seeking a dependable crossover that handles daily commutes and weekend adventures alike.

- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Plus System with Navigation
- Dual Zone Automatic Climate Control
- Remote Vehicle Starter System
- Rear Power Liftgate
- Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert
- Rear Cross Traffic Alert
- Rear Park Assist with Audible Warning
- Heated Driver and Front Passenger Seats
- Factory Installed Trailer Hitch
- 19 Aluminum Wheels
- Redline Edition styling package with Black grille and bowtie emblems
- Outside Heated Power-Adjustable Mirrors
- HD Rear Vision Camera
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- SiriusXM Radio

Engineered with a 2.0L Turbocharged engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, this Equinox delivers responsive handling and fuel efficiency with an EPA-estimated 22 city and 28 highway MPG. The turbocharged powertrain provides the balance of capability and economy that makes daily driving more economical without sacrificing performance.

The Redline Edition elevates the visual presence with distinctive styling cues including a Black grille, 19-inch black aluminum wheels with red accents, and exclusive Black bowtie emblems front and rear. Mosaic Black mirror caps and black window surrounds add cohesive design details that distinguish this model from standard configurations.

Inside, the cabin prioritizes comfort and connectivity with dual-zone automatic climate control, heated front seats, and a leather-wrapped steering wheel. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Plus system with integrated navigation keeps you connected and informed, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration ensures your smartphone integrates seamlessly into your drives.

Safety features work proactively to protect you and your passengers. Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert monitors your surroundings, while Rear Cross Traffic Alert and Rear Park Assist with audible warning provide additional awareness during reversing. The HD rear vision camera gives you a clear view behind the vehicle, complemented by electronic stability control, traction control, and a complete airbag system.

Whether you're loading gear through the rear power liftgate or towing with the factory-installed trailer hitch, this Equinox offers the practicality that makes ownership straightforward and rewarding. With roof rack provisions and abundant interior flexibility, you have the space and functionality to manage life's essentials. Visit our showroom today to experience how this well-equipped Equinox LT can serve your driving needs.
